snippet.title: Leaks In Space | Official Announcement Teaser Trailer | #teasertrailer #announcement #steam #games
snippet.description:
Get ready for the ultimate space survival challenge! 

#LeaksInSpace is an upcoming 2D sandbox space simulation game that combines intense combat, strategic ship building, resource mining, galactic trading, and endless exploration in a vast procedurally generated universe.

Wishlist NOW on Steam! 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3561170/Leaks_In_Space/?utm_source=youtube
Coming Soon - Don't miss the launch!

What makes Leaks in Space unique?
Master the art of battling enemies, mining asteroids, and exploring the depths of space. Will you patch up in time, or will the void claim another victim?
